Desktop builds of Oversample. The web app at https://app.oversample.com needs no install.

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10 and 11 | `oversample_*_x64-setup.exe` |
| Linux, any distribution | `oversample_*_amd64.AppImage` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint | `oversample_*_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE | `oversample-*.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS (untested) | `oversample_*_universal.dmg` |

**Windows:** the installer is not code-signed. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.

**macOS (untested):** this build has not been run on a Mac, so please report what works and what does not. It is not notarized by Apple. The first time you open it, macOS will refuse; then go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.
